[[Asado Desert]] }} (Japanese: '''災厄！依頼者レホール！！''' ''Calamity! The Requesting Raifort!!'') is the 13th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is subtitled (Japanese: '''VS ニャローテ''' ''VS {{tt|Nyarote|Floragato}}''). ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As {{Scarlet}}'s battle against [[Iono]] continues, the latter reveals that her {{p|Mismagius}} has the {{a|Levitate}} [[ability]], rendering any {{type|Ground}} moves useless against it. In response, Scarlet swaps out her {{p|Pikachu}} for {{p|Armarouge}} and attempts to have it use {{m|Night Shade}}. Mismagius avoids the attack by using {{m|Phantom Force}}, then knocks out Armarouge upon resurfacing. Scarlet then sends out {{p|Floragato}}, but it is quickly {{status|confusion|confused}} by Mismagius, which leads it to knock itself out. Scarlet brings Pikachu back into the battle and commands it to attack with {{m|Feint}}. When Mismagius counters with {{m|Confuse Ray}}, Pikachu uses {{m|Double Team}} to multiply its image and raise its [[stat|evasion]] rate. As Iono looks for the real Pikachu, she finds it {{m|Play Nice|playing}} with Mismagius. When Iono yells at her Pokémon to draw its attention back to the battle, Pikachu uses {{m|Thief}} to knock it out, giving Scarlet the victory. Despite losing, Iono gloats that the battle attracted many viewers to her livestream. She awards Scarlet a Gym [[Badge]], even though she initially attempts to refuse it. Approaching Scarlet after the battle, {{adv|Nemona}} asks why she switched out her Pikachu and made the battle harder on herself. This leads Scarlet to reveal that prior to the battle, she had made a deal with Iono to give her an exciting match in exchange for access to a buffet at every food cart in [[Levincia]]. Nemona then takes off to prepare for her battle with Iono as Scarlet leaves to meet her client. Entering an isolated area of the city, Scarlet comes across [[Rika]] and [[Geeta]], as well as [[Raifort]]. She asks for her client to reveal their identity. Meanwhile, as {{Violet}} and {{adv|Arven}} ride through [[Asado Desert]] on {{ga|Miraidon}}, [[Old Roto]] is suddenly hacked by [[Cassiopeia]]. Cassiopeia tells the others that they are nearing the [[Schedar Squad's Base|base of the Schedar Squad]], a group of [[Team Star]] that is expected to soon be hiring someone for security. They advise Violet to raid the base before the security member arrives, to which he agrees. This angers Arven, who asserts that their next goal should be to acquire more [[Herba Mystica]]. Violet then decides to have Arven wait for the Titan while he takes on the base with Miraidon, leaving him behind. Worried about Violet, Arven calls [[Clavell]]. After Raifort recognizes Scarlet's school uniform, the latter determines her to be her client. Rika and Geeta attempt to introduce themselves to Scarlet, but she leads her client past them without looking back. Later, when the two are alone, Raifort reveals that she hired Scarlet to collect information on the [[treasures of ruin|Ruinous Pokémon]], saying she wishes to capture them before they can break free of their seal and wreak havoc across [[Paldea]]. Scarlet agrees to continue helping Raifort, but only on the condition that she will assist a [[PASV05|certain boy]] in enrolling in [[Uva Academy]]. Raifort accepts, then goes on to explain that in order to unseal the Ruinous Pokémon, Scarlet will need the strength of a Pokémon called the "Iron Serpent," revealing she had last seen it being ridden by Violet. The conversation is interrupted when Scarlet suddenly receives a phone call from [[Mela]], who requests that she come protect the Schedar Squad's base. ==Major events== * {{Scarlet}} wins her [[Gym]] battle against [[Iono]]. * {{Violet}} splits off from {{adv|Arven}} to raid the [[Schedar Squad's Base]]. * Scarlet learns from her client, [[Raifort]], that she will require {{ga|Miraidon}} to capture the [[treasures of ruin|Ruinous Pokémon]]. * [[Mela]] asks Scarlet to help defend her base from an assault. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Violet}} * {{Scarlet}} * {{adv|Nemona}} * {{adv|Arven}} * [[Iono]] * [[Geeta]] * [[Rika]] * [[Raifort]] * [[Clavell]] * [[Brassius]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Miraidon}} ({{OP|Violet|Miraidon}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Old Roto]]; {{Violet}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{Scarlet}}'s) * {{p|Tarountula}} ({{Scarlet}}'s) * {{p|Floragato}} ({{Scarlet}}'s) * {{p|Armarouge}} ({{Scarlet}}'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Scarlet]]'s) * {{p|Mabosstiff}} ({{OP|Arven|Mabosstiff}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; {{adv|Arven}}'s) * {{p|Mismagius}} ([[Iono]]'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Iono]]'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Clavell]]'s) * {{p|Mudbray}} * {{p|Capsakid}} * {{p|Cacnea}} * {{p|Rufflet}} (×3) * {{p|Wo-Chien}} (fantasy) * {{p|Chien-Pao}} (fantasy) * {{p|Ting-Lu}} (fantasy) * {{p|Chi-Yu}} (fantasy) {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PASV12 |prevtitle=Stream!
